devices.name: WLED
devices.detail: Prismestra controls individual LEDs on WLED controllers over your local network. Enable DDP on the controller.
devices.detailRu: Prismestra управляет отдельными светодиодами по локальной сети. Включите DDP на контроллере.
devices.note: Connect the controller to your local network and add it in Devices.
devices.noteRu: Подключите контроллер к локальной сети и добавьте его в разделе «Устройства».

devices.name: QuinLED Dig-Uno
devices.note: Works over the local network with WLED firmware that receives DDP.
devices.noteRu: Работает по локальной сети с прошивкой WLED, которая принимает DDP.
devices.detail: Configure the strip’s LED count and add the controller as a WLED device in Prismestra.
devices.detailRu: Задайте число светодиодов в WLED и добавьте контроллер как устройство WLED в Prismestra.

devices.detail: Configure the strip’s LED count and add the controller as a WLED device in Prismestra.
devices.detailRu: Задайте число светодиодов в WLED и добавьте контроллер как устройство WLED в Prismestra.

devices.name: Home Assistant
devices.detail: Choose a light already connected to Home Assistant. The controls depend on what that light can do.
devices.detailRu: Выберите светильник, который уже подключён к Home Assistant. Доступные настройки зависят от светильника.

devices.name: Philips Hue lights (via Home Assistant)
devices.note: Connect the Hue Bridge to Home Assistant and select a Hue light in Prismestra.
devices.noteRu: Подключите Hue Bridge к Home Assistant и выберите светильник Hue в Prismestra.
devices.detail: Uses the light entity from Home Assistant for whole-light commands. Available controls depend on the lamp.
devices.detailRu: Команды идут через Home Assistant на светильник целиком. Доступные настройки зависят от лампы.

devices.name: Alice (Yandex Smart Home)
devices.detail: Sign in with Yandex ID and choose a lamp. Turn it on or off, adjust brightness, or include brightness when applying a scene.
devices.detailRu: Войдите с Яндекс ID и выберите лампу. Её можно включать и выключать, менять яркость или применять яркость вместе со сценой.
devices.note: Open Settings, go to LAN controls, and sign in with Yandex ID to choose a lamp.
devices.noteRu: В настройках откройте управление по сети, войдите с Яндекс ID и выберите лампу.

devices.name: Surplife E1
devices.detail: For a single-segment strip, enter the number of LEDs before applying a scene.
devices.detailRu: Для ленты с одним сегментом укажите число светодиодов, затем примените сцену.
devices.note: Turn on Bluetooth and look for the strip in Devices.
devices.noteRu: Включите Bluetooth и найдите ленту в разделе «Устройства».

devices.name: Surplife BLE legacy 20 groups
devices.detail: Select the layout with 20 lighting groups.
devices.detailRu: Выберите раскладку на 20 групп подсветки.

devices.name: Surplife BLE 153-point preview profile
devices.detail: The 153-point preview uses E104. Use this profile with a single-segment controller that reports 153 points.
devices.detailRu: Профиль предпросмотра на 153 точки использует E104. Выберите его для контроллера с одним сегментом на 153 точки.

devices.name: Surplife E1 153-point optical marker
devices.detail: In a hardware check, a test frame lit the first LED on a 153-LED, single-segment strip. The check covered one position.
devices.detailRu: В тесте на ленте из 153 светодиодов загорелся первый светодиод. Проверили одну позицию.

devices.name: Thermaltake LCD 264A:233C
aliases: TH420 V2 Ultra EX ARGB Sync Black
devices.detail: The TH420 V2 Ultra EX ARGB Sync LCD uses USB ID 264A:233C. Prismestra sends images to the display and reads liquid temperature over a separate interface.
devices.detailRu: Экран TH420 V2 Ultra EX ARGB Sync определяется по USB как 264A:233C. Prismestra выводит изображения и получает температуру жидкости через отдельный интерфейс.
devices.model: Thermaltake TH420 V2 Ultra EX ARGB Sync

devices.name: Gigabyte RGB Fusion 2 USB
devices.detail: On the B650 EAGLE AX, the Prismestra driver controls the two addressable ARGB headers. Set the LED count for each connected header.
devices.detailRu: На B650 EAGLE AX драйвер Prismestra управляет двумя адресными разъёмами ARGB. Укажите число светодиодов для каждого подключённого разъёма.

devices.name: ENE DRAM AUDA0-E6K5-0101
devices.detail: The Prismestra driver supports this controller with eight LEDs per memory module.
devices.detailRu: Драйвер Prismestra поддерживает этот контроллер с восемью светодиодами на модуль памяти.

devices.name: G.SKILL Trident Z5 DDR5 F5-6400J3239G16G
devices.detail: The F5-6400J3239G16G module was identified with an eight-LED ENE AUDA0-E6K5-0101 controller. The driver matches the controller and LED layout.
devices.detailRu: На модуле F5-6400J3239G16G определился контроллер ENE AUDA0-E6K5-0101 с восемью светодиодами. Драйвер проверяет контроллер и число светодиодов.
devices.note: Match the part number printed on your memory module. Trident Z5 kits come in several versions.
devices.noteRu: Сверьте номер на наклейке модуля памяти. У комплектов Trident Z5 несколько версий.

devices.name: Dark Project KD98A
devices.detail: OpenRGB may show this keyboard as “Valkyrie VK99”. Prismestra can send lighting frames through that connection.
devices.detailRu: OpenRGB может показывать эту клавиатуру как «Valkyrie VK99». Prismestra передаёт подсветку через это подключение.

devices.name: BanlanX SP611E
devices.detail: UniLED implements status and whole RGB commands. Need matched advertisement, GATT and full status from one confirmed hardware and firmware revision before binding. No Prismestra adapter.

devices.name: BanlanX SP621E
devices.detail: UniLED lists this separately from SP611E. Shared status markers are insufficient to distinguish the two. Need model-specific identity and Prismestra acceptance.

devices.name: LED Hue SP110E
devices.detail: UniLED implements its model-specific whole-color commands. Need a matching revision, a status fixture and a Prismestra adapter.

devices.name: Govee H6053
aliases: Govee RGBICWW Flow Plus Light Bars
devices.detail: Upstream implements model-dependent zone masks. Need a fixture for this SKU and firmware, physical zone mapping and Prismestra implementation.

devices.name: Govee H6072
devices.detail: Upstream implements model-dependent zone masks. Need distinct SKU and firmware evidence, actual zone count and Prismestra implementation.

devices.name: ELK-BLEDOM
devices.detail: Upstream has multiple command layouts under similar advertised names. Need one revision with a unique descriptor and known write contract before Prismestra implementation.

devices.name: Corsair H150i ELITE LCD XT
devices.detail: Need to match CW-9060075-WW to the exact LCD PID and firmware, then verify exclusive display binding, visible output and cooling coexistence on Windows.

devices.name: Thermalright Trofeo Vision 6.86 V1.02
devices.detail: Published Type 2 panel evidence uses 0416:5302 and 1280×480 JPEG. Need exact panel identity beyond VID/PID, repeated frames and timeout recovery on Windows.

devices.name: Thermalright Frozen Warframe 240
devices.detail: The device registry lists a 320×240 SCSI variant. Need exact panel, orientation and Windows access requirements before using a display-only transport.

devices.name: NZXT Kraken Z53
devices.detail: liquidctl covers the Kraken Z3 1E71:3008 path. Need to pair both interfaces to one instance, verify firmware-specific media behavior and check Windows coexistence with CAM.

devices.name: NZXT Kraken Z63
devices.detail: liquidctl covers the Kraken Z3 1E71:3008 path. Need to pair both interfaces to one instance, verify firmware-specific media behavior and check Windows coexistence with CAM.

devices.name: NZXT Kraken Z73
devices.detail: liquidctl covers the Kraken Z3 1E71:3008 path. Need to pair both interfaces to one instance, verify firmware-specific media behavior and check Windows coexistence with CAM.

devices.name: NZXT Kraken Elite 2023
devices.detail: Separate 1E71:300C path. Upstream describes firmware-specific limitations. Need exact firmware, display-only binding and Windows media tests.

devices.name: NZXT Kraken Elite RGB 2024
devices.detail: Separate 1E71:3012 path. Need to reproduce the upstream static and GIF sequence on the target firmware and verify Windows interface access.

devices.name: Lian Li Galahad II LCD
devices.detail: Upstream uses H.264 over bulk on 0416:7395. Need Windows access, display-only ownership, an encoder plan and evidence that cooling is unaffected.

devices.name: Woox R9077
devices.route: Candidate validation over Home Assistant REST
devices.detail: Upstream exposes brightness, XY color and color temperature. Need the resulting Home Assistant light entity and visible command acceptance for this model.

devices.name: Matter lights via Home Assistant
devices.route: Candidate validation over Home Assistant REST
devices.detail: Need one exact commissioned model and a stable light entity with reported modes and visible command results. The route relies on Home Assistant and its Matter Server.

devices.name: Zigbee lights via ZHA
devices.route: Candidate validation over Home Assistant REST
devices.detail: Need an exact light model, coordinator and entity capability record with visible command results. The route relies on ZHA.

devices.name: Windows Dynamic Lighting
devices.detail: Need a LampArray adapter and tests on one Windows model and OS build covering ownership, topology, visible output and returning control.

devices.name: Dark Project Terra Nova
devices.detail: An external implementation drives the USB RGB controller in a stock ALU81A-family unit. The driver has not been integrated into Prismestra.
devices.detailRu: Сторонний драйвер управляет подсветкой устройства семейства ALU81A по USB. В Prismestra этого драйвера пока нет.

devices.name: Dark Project Terra Nostra
devices.detail: An external implementation covers the stock ALU81A USB controller. QMK and Vial variants need their own firmware check.
devices.detailRu: Сторонний драйвер описывает штатный USB-контроллер ALU81A. Варианты с QMK и Vial требуют отдельной проверки прошивки.

devices.name: NZXT Kraken 240 (2023)
devices.detail: Liquidctl implements image upload for the 240 × 240 display. Prismestra needs a dedicated LCD driver.
devices.detailRu: Liquidctl умеет загружать изображения на экран 240 × 240. Для этого экрана нужен отдельный драйвер в Prismestra.

devices.name: Lian Li UNI FAN TL LCD (wired)
devices.detail: External testing identified the wired 400 × 400 LCD. The RGB controller is a separate connection.
devices.detailRu: В стороннем проекте проверили проводной экран 400 × 400. Подсветка использует отдельный контроллер.

devices.name: Thermalright Grand Vision 360
devices.detail: The external TRCC implementation identifies a 480 × 480 display. Its USB ID is shared, so the protocol handshake must also match.
devices.detailRu: Сторонняя реализация TRCC определяет экран 480 × 480. У USB ID есть совпадения с другими устройствами, поэтому нужна проверка протокола.

devices.name: Thermalright Frozen Warframe 360
devices.detail: The captured 360 mm model uses an HID display path. It requires separate handling from the 240 mm model.
devices.detailRu: На проверенной 360-мм модели экран подключается по HID. Для 240-мм модели используется другой способ связи.

devices.name: BanlanX SP630E
devices.detail: UniLED identifies this controller. It currently needs a Prismestra BLE adapter.
devices.detailRu: UniLED распознаёт этот контроллер. Подключение напрямую по Bluetooth требует драйвера Prismestra.

devices.name: LED Chord SP107E
devices.detail: UniLED lists this BLE controller. Its command format differs from the Surplife path.
devices.detailRu: UniLED указывает этот контроллер в списке. Формат команд отличается от Surplife.

devices.name: Govee H6181
devices.detail: An external integration tested BLE control on firmware 2.03.11. Prismestra has no direct BLE connection for this model.
devices.detailRu: В сторонней интеграции проверяли управление по Bluetooth на прошивке 2.03.11. Прямого подключения по Bluetooth в Prismestra пока нет.

devices.name: Dark Project KD98A Sunset
devices.detail: The manufacturer lists the Sunset variant. The VK99 route observed on a KD98A unit has not been established for this variant.
devices.detailRu: Производитель указывает вариант Sunset отдельно. Подключение через VK99, замеченное на KD98A, для этой версии не подтверждено.

devices.name: G.SKILL Trident Z5 Neo RGB F5-6000J3038F16GX2-TZ5NR
devices.detail: This kit has a separate part number. Its lighting controller has not been matched to a Prismestra driver.
devices.detailRu: У комплекта отдельный артикул. Его контроллер подсветки пока не сопоставлен с драйвером Prismestra.

devices.name: TEAMGROUP T-FORCE DELTA RGB DDR5 FF3D532G6000HC30DC01
devices.detail: A report from an AM5 system could not detect this kit. Its Windows controller match is still unknown.
devices.detailRu: В отчёте с компьютера AM5 этот комплект не обнаружился. Совпадение контроллера в Windows пока не подтверждено.

devices.name: Kingston FURY Renegade DDR5 RGB Limited Edition
aliases: Kingston FURY Renegade RGB Limited Edition
devices.detail: The standard Renegade SPD detection path excludes the Limited Edition identifier. A working lighting route for this kit is unconfirmed.
devices.detailRu: Идентификатор Limited Edition исключён из обычного распознавания Renegade по SPD. Рабочее подключение для этого комплекта пока не подтверждено.
